about_the_game:
This demo gives you access to the entire prologue of Creature Containment!

Armed with an advanced MCOMP computer, the player can build up their base to fight the goblin threat coming from below. Read emails, build shops, and equip Operators to be sent into the field.

Once in the field, fight through 10 levels, including a boss, to try and contain the ever-growing Goblin threat.

content_descriptors.notes: This game features semi-realistic depictions of violence. The player can kill various enemies, with blood and gore present after doing so. The player can also choose to consume various drugs in game that provide benefits and drawbacks.
